name: Rick Lazio
summary: Enrico Anthony Lazio (; born March 13, 1958) is an American attorney and former four-term U.S. representative from the State of New York. A Long Island native, Lazio became well-known during his bid for U.S. Senate in New York's 2000 Senate election; he was defeated by Hillary Rodham Clinton.  Lazio also ran unsuccessfully for the 2010 New York State Republican Party gubernatorial nomination.
